title: .cache/milestones.json
description: The milestone tracker of one checkout: what has to be completed before the work can go on. The agent session writes it through scripts/milestones.py; the Claude Code statusline (scripts/statusline) and the /milestones skill read it. Per checkout and gitignored (.cache/). milestones.py validates the same rules without a library (the statusline runs it on every refresh); tests/milestones/test_milestones.py keeps the two in step.

title.description: What the milestones lead to, short: it opens the statusline segment ("To F2/F3").

updated.description: ISO 8601 time of the last write by milestones.py.

items.description: The milestones in the order they are to be completed.

id.description: Stable number, unique in the file; `set` and `remove` take it.

state.description: done counts full on the bar, doing half.

left.description: What is left to complete it.

needs.description: Who must act, e.g. you; an item that needs the user puts a marker on the statusline.

started.description: ISO 8601 time the item first went to doing (written by milestones.py).

finished.description: ISO 8601 time the item went to done (written by milestones.py; removed when it leaves done).
